# Fighter (`classes:fighter`)
**Hit Die:** d10 | **Saving Throws:** [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [CON](../ability-scores/con.md)
**Primary Ability:** Choose 1: [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md)
**Subclasses:** [Champion](../subclasses/champion.md)
**Proficiencies:** [All armor](../proficiencies/all-armor.md), [Shields](../proficiencies/shields.md), [Simple Weapons](../proficiencies/simple-weapons.md), [Martial Weapons](../proficiencies/martial-weapons.md), [Saving Throw: STR](../proficiencies/saving-throw-str.md), [Saving Throw: CON](../proficiencies/saving-throw-con.md)

## Proficiency Choices
- Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Perception, or Survival ([Skill: Acrobatics](../proficiencies/skill-acrobatics.md), [Skill: Animal Handling](../proficiencies/skill-animal-handling.md), [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md), [Skill: History](../proficiencies/skill-history.md), [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md), [Skill: Intimidation](../proficiencies/skill-intimidation.md), [Skill: Persuasion](../proficiencies/skill-persuasion.md), [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md), [Skill: Survival](../proficiencies/skill-survival.md))

## Starting Equipment
- (a) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP; (b) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (c) 155 GP ([Chain Mail](../equipment/chain-mail.md), [Greatsword](../equipment/greatsword.md), [Flail](../equipment/flail.md), [Javelin](../equipment/javelin.md), [Dungeoneer's Pack](../equipment/dungeoneer-pack.md), [Studded Leather Armor](../equipment/studded-leather-armor.md), [Scimitar](../equipment/scimitar.md), [Shortsword](../equipment/shortsword.md), [Longbow](../equipment/longbow.md), [Arrows](../equipment/arrows.md), [Quiver](../equipment/quiver.md))

## Multiclassing
- Prerequisites: Choose 1: [STR](../ability-scores/str.md), [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md)
- Proficiencies: [Light Armor](../proficiencies/light-armor.md), [Medium Armor](../proficiencies/medium-armor.md), [Shields](../proficiencies/shields.md), [Martial Weapons](../proficiencies/martial-weapons.md)
